review.brief: Validate telemetry-add-tire-pressure-columns (diff c0e309e..HEAD). (1) Module boundaries: telemetry edits only its module; the only tesla edit is the additive VehicleStateTesla DTO fields (T1); no HTML, no cross-module DB access, no new Reader method; pgtype confined to service.go/mapping.go (not in any public type). (2) Conventions: bar→PSI honors the go-conventions companion non-negotiable (nil-safe *float64 value-receiver methods mirroring OdometerKm), barToPSI is a package constant, ptr()/NULL semantics match the charge-enrichment precedent (nil=not reported/pre-migration, reported 0.0 stored non-NULL). (3) DB vs user-confirmed design (D1): exactly 4 nullable REAL columns, no DEFAULT/NOT NULL/CHECK, NO new index; a mismatch is a blocker. SPECIAL ATTENTION: columns are REAL so the impl uses pgtype.Float4 + float64PtrToPgFloat4/pgNullableFloat4AsFloat64 (design text mentioned Float8) — verify the float64↔float32 narrowing/widening is correct and lossless enough, and that this is a sound resolution, not a bug. (4) tesla-exploration test-free rule: no _test.go calls the live Fleet API / Raw* methods; go test ./... incurs no paid call. (5) Spec delta coverage: specs/telemetry/spec.md scenarios match the implemented behavior; D2/D3 (gateway display) correctly OUT of scope (no gateway edits). (6) Anti-gaming: tasks/criteria not weakened; no self-approved statuses. Read the diff, not the whole module. Default to changes-requested on any doubt.
